name: ICCTG PPS–hydroxyzine
aliases: Interstitial Cystitis Clinical Trials Group pilot trial
question: Do oral pentosan polysulfate sodium, hydroxyzine, or their combination improve patient-reported global response in interstitial cystitis?

design.blinding: not specified in the primary abstract

arms.label: Oral pentosan polysulfate sodium plus hydroxyzine

design.population: 121 randomized participants met NIH–NIDDK interstitial cystitis criteria and reported at least moderate pain and frequency for at least six months.
design.locator: PubMed abstract, Purpose; Materials and Methods; Results

verdictNote: Neither pooled drug comparison reached statistical significance; recruitment and follow-up limited precision.
takeaway: In a factorial pilot, oral pentosan polysulfate sodium and hydroxyzine were compared with their corresponding no-agent groups. Global response was 34% versus 18% for PPS (P = 0.064) and 31% versus 20% for hydroxyzine (P = 0.26).

reports.label: Pilot factorial trial
reports.dateLocator: PubMed citation and Crossref published-print: September 2003; Europe PMC firstPublicationDate: 2003-09-01
reports.citation: Sant GR, Propert KJ, Hanno PM, et al. "A Pilot Clinical Trial of Oral Pentosan Polysulfate and Oral Hydroxyzine in Patients With Interstitial Cystitis." *J Urol.* 2003;170(3):810-815. doi:10.1097/01.ju.0000083020.06212.3d
reports.followUp: Complete follow-up data in 79% of randomized participants; assessment interval not given in the primary abstract

results.measure: Pooled PPS-assigned groups versus groups without PPS
results.note: Response: 34% with PPS versus 18% without PPS. The abstract gives neither arm-specific counts nor a prespecified efficacy threshold.
results.locator: PubMed abstract, Materials and Methods; Results

results.measure: Pooled hydroxyzine-assigned groups versus groups without hydroxyzine
results.note: Response: 31% with hydroxyzine versus 20% without hydroxyzine. The abstract gives neither arm-specific counts nor a prespecified efficacy threshold.
results.locator: PubMed abstract, Materials and Methods; Results

results.endpoint: Symptom indexes, pain, urgency, and frequency
results.note: No treatment differences were reported for any secondary endpoint; the abstract provides no estimates.
results.locator: PubMed abstract, Materials and Methods; Results

harms.label: Adverse events
harms.note: Mostly minor; the abstract gives no event counts or arm-specific rates.

delivery.label: Recruitment
delivery.value: 121 participants randomized over 18 months, 89% of a target of 136 planned for 10 months of recruitment.
delivery.locator: PubMed abstract, Materials and Methods; Results
